program_name: Master of Science in Management (By Research)

requirements.general_text: Any of these: Bachelor’s Degree (Level 6, MOH) in the field of dentistry with a minimum CGPA of 2.75 or equivalent, as accepted by the HEP Senate Bachelor’s Degree (Level 6, MOH) in the field of Dentistry or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 and did not reach a CGPA of 2.75 may be admitted subject to rigorous internal assessment Bachelor’s Degree (Level 6 MOH) in the field of Dentistry or equivalent but CGPA of 2.50 may be admitted subject to a minimum of 5 years working experience in the relevant field. English Proficiency Requirements (International Students): International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score of 5.0 or its equivalent. If a student does not meet this requirement, HEPs must offer English proficiency courses to ensure that the student’s proficiency is sufficient to meet the needs of the program.
